title: "tide_models"
author: "Brandon Koskie"

output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(broom)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(here)

# -------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load & join data
# -------------------------------------------------
sensor_data <- read_csv(here("cleaned_data/master_data_pivot.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

combined <- sensor_data %>%
  filter(site == "Kanewai", variable %in% c("pH", "oxygen")) %>%
  left_join(
    tide_data %>% rename(tide_m = water_level_m),
    by = "date_time_hst"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tide_m), !is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(
    hour = hour(date_time_hst),
    is_day = hour >= 6 & hour < 18
  )

# -------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build clean scorecard
# -------------------------------------------------
scorecard <- combined %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    overall_cor = cor(value, tide_m, use = "complete.obs"),
    
    # Linear model
    model = list(lm(value ~ tide_m, data = cur_data())),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract coefficient for tide
    tide_effect = map_dbl(model, ~ coef(.x)["tide_m"]),
    conf_low    = map_dbl(model, ~ confint(.x)["tide_m", 1]),
    conf_high   = map_dbl(model, ~ confint(.x)["tide_m", 2]),
    
    # Extract R² and p-value
    r_squared   = map_dbl(model, ~ summary(.x)$r.squared),
    p_value     = map_dbl(model, ~ summary(.x)$coefficients["tide_m", "Pr(>|t|)"])
  ) %>%
  select(variable, overall_cor, tide_effect, conf_low, conf_high, r_squared, p_value)

# -------------------------------------------------
# 3. Day vs Night correlations
# -------------------------------------------------
day_night <- combined %>%
  group_by(variable, is_day) %>%
  summarise(
    correlation = cor(value, tide_m, use = "complete.obs"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(period = ifelse(is_day, "Day", "Night")) %>%
  select(variable, period, correlation) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = period, values_from = correlation)

# -------------------------------------------------
# 4. Final easy-to-read table
# -------------------------------------------------
kanewai_final_scorecard <- scorecard %>%
  left_join(day_night, by = "variable") %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(overall_cor, tide_effect, conf_low, conf_high, r_squared, Day, Night),
           ~ round(.x, 3)),
    p_value = signif(p_value, 3)
  )

print(kanewai_final_scorecard)
```
